transitions.action: Client publishes token to authz-info topic and disconnects; Broker validates token

transitions.event: CONNECT with Authentication Method 'ace' and valid token
transitions.action: Broker performs PoP validation on provided token
Client sends CONNECT packet with valid token; Broker validates token and accepts connection

transitions.event: Token expiration check fails or authorization failure on PUBLISH/SUBSCRIBE/CONNECT
transitions.action: Broker sends DISCONNECT packet with reason code 0x87 (Not authorized) and closes Network Connection

transitions.event: Client sends AUTH packet with reason code 0x19 (Reauthentication)
transitions.action: Broker validates new token; if successful, continues session; if failed, sends DISCONNECT and closes connection

transitions.event: Client disconnects normally or network error occurs
